title: 剃头匠的谢幕
logline: 扎根老城区三十年的理发店迎来最后营业日，老板为老街坊完成最后一次剃头，宣告传统理发手艺的阶段性谢幕，传递手艺传承的理念。

shots.narrationZh: 这条街的灯，亮了三十年
shots.narrationEn: The light on this street has been on for thirty years.
shots.visual: A middle-aged barber polishes the red-and-white revolving barber pole outside a shabby barbershop in an old town alley.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静怀旧，语速偏慢，‘三十年’重读，气息平稳带感慨尾韵，像对着旧物轻声诉说

shots.narrationZh: 老李的头，我剃了三十年
shots.narrationEn: I've cut Old Li's hair for thirty years.
shots.visual: The barber trims the hair of an elderly regular customer with vintage scissors inside the cluttered, dim barbershop.
shots.ttsDirection: 暖柔亲切，语速平稳，‘三十年’重读，气息带暖意，像和老街坊唠家常的熟稔感

shots.narrationZh: 镜子擦干净了，以后也亮堂
shots.narrationEn: I polished the mirrors till they're bright and clear.
shots.visual: The barber wipes an old oval wall mirror with a soft cloth, his reflection visible in the glass.
shots.ttsDirection: 释然平静，语速稍缓，‘亮堂’重读，气息轻缓，像放下心头事的释然松弛感

shots.narrationZh: 这门手艺，到这儿就收工了
shots.narrationEn: This craft's final shift ends here today.
shots.visual: The barber gently lifts the revolving barber pole off its metal mount.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静郑重，语速偏慢，‘收工了’重读，气息下沉，带着对三十载手艺的郑重道别感

shots.narrationZh: 老手艺的薪火，等你接力
shots.narrationEn: The flame of this craft waits for you to carry on.
shots.visual: The barber places his well-worn straight razor into a glass display case beside a set of new traditional barber tools, with the slogan 'Carry the Craft' fading in on screen.
shots.ttsDirection: 温和期许，语速平稳，‘等你接力’重读，气息轻扬，带着对传承的暖切期许感
